verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community evidence of user-facing data retention/deletion controls (e.g., account deletion, message auto-purge, data export/opt-out settings); only unrelated dev API docs and community complaints about breaches/image scanning are present, none of which address deletion or retention configuration. Missing for 10: docs on account/data deletion process, retention policy configuration, data export tools, and any user controls over how long Discord retains messages/data.
